recently.en: Another important development in British food recently has been the transformation of the pub.
recently.zh: 最近英国食物的另一个重要发展是酒吧的改造。

recently.en: Recently, Finland has shown that the problem can be solved.
recently.zh: 最近，芬兰证明了这个问题是可以解决的。

recently.en: What about you? Well, recently I was bitten by a mosquito and, as you know, when you get bitten by a mosquito, it's really itchy.
recently.zh: What about you? Well, recently I was bitten by a mosquito and, as you know, when you get bitten by a mosquito, it's really itchy.

recently.en: Countries like this with great food cultures partly have a great food culture because people were around their food for much longer and much more recently.
recently.zh: 像这样拥有伟大饮食文化的国家，部分原因在于人们围绕着他们的食物生活了更长时间，而且更近。

remove.en: And so, we start to scratch at the very same area where we itch and remove it.
remove.zh: And so, we start to scratch at the very same area where we itch and remove it.

remove.en: Sonja, what actually is itchiness? So, by scratching the skin, we remove parasites or plants or anything that does not belong on the skin.
remove.zh: Sonja, what actually is itchiness? So, by scratching the skin, we remove parasites or plants or anything that does not belong on the skin.

rejection.en: So, rejection means saying no to someone or refusing to accept their idea or suggestion.
rejection.zh: “Rejection”的意思是对某人说“不”，或者拒绝接受他们的想法或提议。

rejection.en: And probably it's quite a good thing to experience rejection, even if it doesn't feel nice.
rejection.zh: 而且，即便体验拒绝的感觉并不好受，但这可能也是件挺好的事。

refuse.en: So, rejection means saying no to someone or refusing to accept their idea or suggestion.
refuse.zh: “Rejection”的意思是对某人说“不”，或者拒绝接受他们的想法或提议。

refuse.en: That's really impressive. It is. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we learned in this programme, starting with rejection, which means saying no or refusing an idea or suggestion.
refuse.zh: 那真是太厉害了。确实是。好了，我们来回顾一下本期节目中学到的词汇吧，首先是“rejection”，意思是对某人说不，或拒绝某种想法或提议。

reject.en: It's a social media trend where people record themselves talking to strangers and sometimes being rejected.
reject.zh: 这是一种社交媒体潮流，人们会录下自己与陌生人搭话，有时还会被拒绝的过程。

reject.en: OK Neil. So, most people don't like being rejected, but one thing to try might be something called rejection therapy.
reject.zh: 好的，Neil。大多数人都不喜欢被拒绝，但有一种可以尝试的方法，叫做“拒绝疗法”。

reject.en: Italy banned nuclear power after Chernobyl, and confirmed that ban again after Fukushima, when 94% of voters rejected building new reactors .
reject.zh: 意大利在切尔诺贝利事故后禁止了核电，并在福岛事故后再次确认了这一禁令，当时94%的选民投票反对建造新反应堆。

record.en: It's a social media trend where people record themselves talking to strangers and sometimes being rejected.
record.zh: 这是一种社交媒体潮流，人们会录下自己与陌生人搭话，有时还会被拒绝的过程。

revolutionary.en: Today, that number is zero. And many countries, especially in Europe, have gone a similar route: initial excitement in the post-war period about this "new" and revolutionary technology, and then a turn towards protest and opposition.
revolutionary.zh: 如今，这一数字为零。许多国家，尤其是欧洲国家，都走过了一条相似的道路：战后初期对这项“全新”且具有革命性的技术充满热情，随后转向抗议和反对。

renaissance.en: People have started talking about a new nuclear age, a nuclear renaissance , where nuclear energy is treated not as "the answer" to how we power the planet, but as "part of the answer".
renaissance.zh: 人们开始谈论一个新的核能时代、一场核能复兴，核能不再被视为解决地球供电问题的“唯一答案”，而是“答案的一部分”。

result.en: And in some cases, this has resulted in some spectacular U-turns .
result.zh: 在某些情况下，这导致了一些令人惊叹的“大转向”。

result.en: This was the result of World War II. There were no spices.
result.zh: 这是第二次世界大战的结果。没有香料。

reactor.en: But 2026 has been the year SMRs, the small modular reactors , they started to look real.
reactor.zh: 但2026年是 SMR，也就是小型模块化反应堆，开始走向现实的一年。

reactor.en: And the government didn't just decide to keep the remaining reactors running.
reactor.zh: 而且政府不仅决定让剩余的反应堆继续运行。

repeal.en: It repealed the law completely, cancelling it as if it had never existed.
repeal.zh: 它彻底废除了这项法律，将其撤销，就像它从未存在过一样。

remain.en: And the government didn't just decide to keep the remaining reactors running.
remain.zh: 而且政府不仅决定让剩余的反应堆继续运行。

reverse.en: Even in countries that haven't reversed course entirely, the tone has changed.
reverse.zh: 即使在没有彻底掉头的国家，基调也变了。

rely.en: Food culture there relies on using lots of intense flavors and spices.
rely.zh: 那里的饮食文化依赖于使用大量浓郁的风味和香料。

rely.en: Traditional British cooking relied on the flavor of the main ingredients.
rely.zh: 传统的英国烹饪依赖于主要食材的风味。

rely.en: Or in fact relying on anyone else for that matter .
rely.zh: 或者说，依赖任何人都不明智。

rely.en: After the Russian invasion of Ukraine, it became clear that relying on cheap Russian gas hadn't been the smartest move.
rely.zh: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，事实证明，依赖廉价的俄罗斯天然气并不是最明智的举动。

reliable.en: Grid engineers call this baseload power : a steady, reliable supply that is always there, whatever the weather.
reliable.zh: 电网工程师称之为“基荷电力”：一种无论天气如何，始终稳定、可靠的供应。

reliable.en: These data centres need reliable, 24/7 energy.
reliable.zh: 这些数据中心需要全天候24小时不间断的可靠能源。

relative.en: Wind and solar are cheap, and they are quick and easy to build, relative to nuclear at least.
relative.zh: 风能和太阳能很便宜，而且至少相对于核能来说，它们的建设速度快且容易。

requirement.en: Then came generative AI which, as I'm sure you know, or might remember from episode 585, has much more intensive energy requirements.
requirement.zh: 接着，生成式人工智能横空出世，相信大家也知道，或者可能还记得第585期节目里讲过的，它对能源的需求要密集得多。

real.en: But 2026 has been the year SMRs, the small modular reactors , they started to look real.
real.zh: 但2026年是 SMR，也就是小型模块化反应堆，开始走向现实的一年。

real.en: During the First World War, Britain experienced real food shortages .
real.zh: 第一次世界大战期间，英国经历了真正的食物短缺。

real.en: To put it in real terms, Goldman Sachs now projects that electricity demand from data centres will grow by 160% by 2030, driven largely by AI.
real.zh: 具体来说，高盛目前预计，在人工智能的极大推动下，到2030年，数据中心的用电需求将增长160%。

reasonable.en: It's a lot when you think that it's like the electricity used by 18 million people, but if you think that this is powering products used by a large proportion of the world's population, perhaps it seems more reasonable.
reasonable.zh: 如果你想到这相当于1800万人的用电量，那确实很多；但如果你想到这为全球很大一部分人口所使用的产品提供了动力，也许就显得更合理了。

regulation.en: For decades, nuclear power depended almost entirely on governments: government funding, government regulation, government risk-taking, because private investors found it too expensive and too slow.
regulation.zh: 几十年来，核电几乎完全依赖政府：政府出资、政府监管、政府承担风险，因为私人投资者觉得它太昂贵、见效太慢。

release.en: Sceptics point out that SMRs are, so far, mostly a story told in press releases and government funding announcements, not in electricity actually flowing onto the grid .
release.zh: 怀疑论者指出，到目前为止，SMR 主要还只是新闻稿和政府拨款公告里的故事，并没有真正向电网输送电力。

remains.en: Of course, spent nuclear fuel is dangerous, and it remains radioactive for thousands of years.
remains.zh: 当然，乏核燃料确实很危险，而且它的放射性会持续数千年。

reaction.en: A fusion reaction has the opposite problem: it is incredibly difficult to keep going.
reaction.zh: 聚变反应面临的问题则截然相反：维持聚变反应极其困难。

reaction.en: If anything goes wrong, the conditions collapse and the reaction simply stops.
reaction.zh: 一旦出现任何差错，反应条件便会瓦解，反应直接停止。

reputation.en: Countries such as France and Italy have really developed reputations as great sophisticated cuisines.
reputation.zh: 法国和意大利等国家确实树立了伟大、复杂的菜系的名声。

reputation.en: But what do you think? Does British food deserve its bad reputation?
reputation.zh: 不过你是怎么想的呢？英国食物配得上它的恶名吗？

refine.en: Cooking became more refined in France. Chefs began developing new techniques.
refine.zh: 在法国，烹饪变得更加精细。厨师们开始开发新技术。

recipe.en: Spices appear in traditional British recipes for meat, desserts, sauces, baked goods, and drinks.
recipe.zh: 香料出现在肉类、甜点、酱汁、烘焙食品和饮料的传统英国食谱中。

recipe.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
recipe.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。

resource.en: People could use this land for animals or to grow food or to collect resources such as firewood.
resource.zh: 人们可以把这块土地用于饲养动物、种植食物或收集木柴等资源。

revolution.en: The Industrial Revolution changed Britain from an agricultural society into an urban, industrial society.
revolution.zh: 工业革命将英国从一个农业社会变成了一个城市化的工业社会。

revolution.en: This is what people started to eat. The Industrial Revolution also changed the way food was produced.
revolution.zh: 这就是人们开始吃的东西。工业革命也改变了食物的生产方式。

respect.en: British chefs have also become really internationally respected.
respect.zh: 英国厨师也变得真正受到国际尊重。

respect.en: This was a big improvement in some respects .
respect.zh: 在某些方面，这是一个巨大的改进。

reach.en: France only reached the level of not being an agricultural society in the 1930s, Italy in the 1950s, Spain in the 1950s as well, Japan in the 1920s, China in the 2000s.
reach.zh: 法国直到20世纪30年代才达到不再是农业社会的水平，意大利在20世纪50年代，西班牙也是在20世纪50年代，日本在20世纪20年代，中国在2000年代。

restrict.en: Items like meat, butter, bacon, sugar, eggs, and cheese were restricted.
restrict.zh: 肉类、黄油、培根、糖、鸡蛋和奶酪等物品受到限制。

relevant.en: Perhaps the best example I can think of, one that’s relevant to where I live now, is the famous Japanese noodle dish “ ramen “.
relevant.zh: 我能想到的最好的例子，一个与我现在居住的地方相关的例子，是著名的日本面条“拉面”。

regular.en: Usually, eating out at a restaurant might be something a family does once or twice a month maybe less, maybe more, but it’s not something completely regular.
regular.zh: 通常，在餐馆吃饭可能是家庭一个月进行一两次的事情，也许更少，也许更多，但这并不是完全规律的。

recommend.en: It’s incredibly delicious, and I’d recommend going to a nice pub and ordering a nice Sunday roast if you can.
recommend.zh: 它极其美味，如果可以的话，我建议去一个不错的酒吧点一份美味的周日烤肉。

represent.en: And there is the food that represents modern Britain.
represent.zh: 还有代表现代英国的食物。

reality.en: The reality is that perhaps British food is not the best cuisine in the world.
reality.zh: 现实情况是，英国料理或许确实称不上世界顶级美食。

relate.en: It’s related to industrialization, war, rationing, social changes, and Britain’s relationship with the rest of the world.
relate.zh: 这与工业化、战争、配给制、社会变革，以及英国与世界其他国家的关系息息相关。

relationship.en: It’s related to industrialization, war, rationing, social changes, and Britain’s relationship with the rest of the world.
relationship.zh: 这与工业化、战争、配给制、社会变革，以及英国与世界其他国家的关系息息相关。
